representation_payload.definition: four real64 support arrays x,z,dzdx,logk; excludes descriptors, cache keys and container metadata

finding: Adaptive representation payload is small enough that a run-lifetime exact-key registry at MultiSWAP scale is plausible. Rebuilding an over-capacity representation repeatedly is far more expensive than retaining several kilobytes of immutable support arrays.
design_implication: Prefer a memory-budgeted exact-key run-lifetime registry with uncached fallback after the budget is exhausted over a tiny 32-entry no-eviction cache or workload-sensitive LRU.
nonclaims: The 256 synthetic perturbations are not a soil-population distribution.
Projected 10000-entry memory excludes fixed metadata and allocatable descriptors.
No application-level speed claim is made.
